title: App Builder
subtitle: Build ontology-backed apps from Object Types, Actions, and Functions. Publish them for use in Apps.
wizardSubtitle: Give it a name, then set Resources and compose the A2UI layout in Source.
name: Name
nameHint: Next: Settings for Resources / Loaders, then Design → Source for layout.
sourceEditHint: Edit the A2UI message JSON by hand, then Save. Invalid JSON or catalog props are rejected.
dataModelHint: Live runtime state of the Preview surface (A2UI DataModel). Paths are surface keys, not platform APIs. Configure Resources and Loaders under Settings; edit updateDataModel seeds in Source.
dataModelConfigHint: Each loader fetches ontology instances into a dataPath. Change fields and save, or add a loader. Pair with a List bound to the same path in Source for display.
dataModelLoadMapEmpty: No OntoObjectList loaders yet — add one below (requires objectTypes in Resources).
dataModelLiveHint: Read-only snapshot of the same DataModel Preview is using. Switch to Preview then back if it looks stale.
resourcesEditHint: Allowlist existing ontology api names this app may use. Builder does not create them.
journeyHint: Complete these steps in Settings and Source. Click Go to jump.

journey.resourcesHint: Pick Object Types, Actions, and Functions (Settings).
journey.layoutHint: Compose List / Modal in Source (including any updateDataModel).

publishNeedsBindings: Set Resources (Settings) and a valid layout before publishing.
removedComponentsHint: Source still uses removed components (OntoKanbanBoard, OntoActionForm, OntoActionButton, OntoFunctionButton, or OntoObjectLink). Click Reset layout, then compose OntoObjectList + List + Modal/TextField in Source.
legacyBoardHint: Resources still use the old board shape (objectType, columns, …). Click Reset layout, set objectTypes/actions/functions, then compose the layout again.
settingsGeneralHint: App identity shown in App Builder and the Apps gallery.
settingsResourcesHint: Allowlist Object Types, Actions, and Functions this app may use. Builder does not create them.
settingsLoadersHint: OntoObjectList loaders fetch instances into DataModel paths at runtime. Pair each with a List on the same path in Source.
settingsLoadersNeedResources: Add object types under Resources first, then configure loaders.
settingsVersionsHint: Published snapshots. Rollback restores a previous published version as the current draft.
